notes.title: A Humble Thank You from Us
notes.content:
A Humble Thank You from Us,

We wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank you for playing our demo! As two indie devs working on our very first game, it means the world to us that you took the time to explore what we've created so far. Your support and feedback are invaluable, helping us shape the game in ways we hadn’t even considered before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187284/9907c6cc962332591f54fc532a31c4740b0f4b52.png[/img]

What We Learned

Since this is our first game, every bit of feedback we've received has been a huge learning experience. Hearing your thoughts has given us fresh perspectives on what works, what doesn't, and where we can take the game next. You’ve helped us realize new ways to improve the gameplay, fix bugs we might’ve missed, and even inspired us to explore ideas we hadn’t originally thought of.

While the demo will remain up for now, we want you to know that a lot will change and be added over time. We're hard at work making improvements, polishing what you’ve already seen, and incorporating new features based on what you’ve shared with us.

We’ll keep updating the game as we go, and we invite you to check back often to see the progress. Your continued support means everything to us, and we’re excited to share this evolving journey with you!

With heartfelt gratitude,
Ezgi & Ali
